corpus.processing: main-stage sources at released proportions, without the card's repeat factors

model.architecture: decoder-only, SwiGLU, mlp_ratio 8, RoPE, RMSNorm with affine eps 1e-6, no biases, untied embeddings, init normal std 0.02 truncated at 3 std

eval.metric: c4_en_bits_per_token: mean next-token cross-entropy on held-out C4-en validation, in nats divided by ln 2, at the final checkpoint
eval.data: the OLMo in-loop evaluator c4_en-validation (v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val); public counterpart allenai/paloma subset c4_en, validation split (gated)
eval.unverified: whether the in-loop file equals Paloma's c4_en validation split or a subsample; the replication uses Paloma c4_en validation for every run, so all recipes share one evaluation set
eval.decontamination: documents in any training corpus exactly matching a Paloma c4_en validation or test document are removed before training
